# pve_node_disk_zfs (Resource)

ZFS pool created on a node's disk(s).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_disk_zfs" "example" {
devices = "CHANGE_ME"
name = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
raidlevel = "single"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `devices` (String) The block devices you want to create the zpool on.
- `name` (String) The storage identifier.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `raidlevel` (String) The RAID level to use. One of: `single`, `mirror`, `raid10`, `raidz`, `raidz2`, `raidz3`, `draid`, `draid2`, `draid3`.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Configure storage using the zpool. (default: 0)
- `ashift` (Number) Pool sector size exponent. (default: 12)
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) Marks associated storage(s) as not available on this node anymore or removes them from the configuration (if configured for this node only). (default: 0)
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) Also wipe disks so they can be repurposed afterwards. (default: 0)
- `compression` (String) The compression algorithm to use. (default: on) One of: `on`, `off`, `gzip`, `lz4`, `lzjb`, `zle`, `zstd`.
- `draid_config` (String) data=<integer> ,spares=<integer>

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Information about the recommended action to fix the state.
- `children` (Attributes List) The pool configuration information, including the vdevs for each section (e.g. spares, cache), may be nested. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--children))
- `errors` (String) Information about the errors on the zpool.
- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/name (also the `terraform import` format).
- `scan` (String) Information about the last/current scrub.
- `state` (String) The state of the zpool.
- `status` (String) Information about the state of the zpool.

<a id="nestedatt--children"></a>
### Nested Schema for `children`

Read-Only:

- `cksum` (Number)
- `msg` (String) An optional message about the vdev.
- `name` (String) The name of the vdev or section.
- `read` (Number)
- `state` (String) The state of the vdev.
- `write` (Number)
